summary: A toggle for one on/off setting that takes effect as a value of a form or of the page. Form-associated: it submits its value while on, resets with its form, follows a disabled fieldset and validates required. Has a visible label, an optional description and error message, and two sizes.

checked.note: Whether the switch is on. Registered alias of selected (spec/api.json), spelled like the native checkbox. As on <input type=checkbox>, the attribute is the default state (what form.reset() restores) and the property is the current state; user toggling changes the property only.

value.note: What is submitted under name while the switch is on. Nothing is submitted while it is off (native checkbox semantics).

name.note: The name the value is submitted under. Owned by the FormAssociated mixin.

disabled.note: Not focusable, not toggleable, not submitted. A <fieldset disabled> ancestor disables it too without touching this attribute (mixin's isDisabled).

required.note: The switch must be on for the form to be valid (native valueMissing on the inner checkbox, mirrored to the host).

label.note: Visible label next to the switch and its accessible name. Clicking it toggles the switch. Empty label logs a one-time console warning (NativeControl).

description.note: Hint under the label, exposed as the switch's accessible description.

errorMessage.note: Why the setting is not accepted. Shown and added to the accessible description only while validation is error.

validation.note: Author-controlled error look: error shows the error ring and errorMessage and sets aria-invalid. Presentation only; it does not change form validity (required does). See Q3.

size.note: Track and thumb size, from the size vocabulary. Label and description text do not change size.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.notes: Host. Lays out the track and the text column in a row, track first.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.notes: Pill-shaped track; its fill shows the state (off: track-off, on: track-on). Carries the focus ring and the error ring.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Native <input type=checkbox role=switch>, transparent and covering the whole track so the track is its hit target. Holds focus, state, required and validity (the validation anchor).

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Round knob, inset from the track edge; at the start while off, at the end while on (mirrored in RTL). Size is the track height minus twice the inset. Decorative, hidden from assistive technology.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> pointing at the control, so a click on it toggles the switch.

anatomy.name: description
anatomy.notes: Rendered only when description is non-empty, under the label.

anatomy.name: error-message
anatomy.notes: Rendered only while validation is error and errorMessage is non-empty, under the description.

change.note: After the user toggles the switch (click, label click, Space). Re-dispatched composed from the host by NativeControl; the form value is already synced when it fires. Not fired for programmatic checked changes or form.reset().

input.note: The inner checkbox's native input event, composed by the platform, so it reaches host listeners unchanged. Same triggers as change.

checked.note: Thumb slides to the end over motion-duration with motion-easing; no transition under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

focus-visible.trigger: Keyboard focus on the control (:focus-visible); exposed on the host as :state(focus-visible).

disabled.trigger: disabled, or a disabled fieldset ancestor (:host(:disabled)).
disabled.note: Whole component (track, label, description) dimmed; cursor not-allowed; label click does nothing.

invalid.note: Ring around the track in error-color and the error message shown. While focus-visible, the focus ring replaces the error ring.

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: label prop, rendered as a <label for> of the inner control. A <label for> outside pointing at the host activates it but does not name it (rule form-associated-controls).

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated(NativeControl(LitElement)). formValue: value while checked, else null. formReset: checked = hasAttribute('checked'). formStateRestore: checked = state !== null. validationAnchor: the inner checkbox (NativeControl default), rendered with ?required and ?disabled=${isDisabled}. syncFormState() is called in the change handler before change is re-dispatched.

accessibility.targetSize: Track 32x20 (medium), 24x16 (small). The visible label is part of the target (clicking it toggles), which meets WCAG 2.5.8; the small size relies on that.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: focus-ring-width ring in focus-ring-color around the track on :focus-visible only; never removed.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Empty label: one console.warn per instance (NativeControl).

keyboard.Tab: Moves focus to and from the switch (one tab stop; skipped while disabled).
keyboard.Space: Toggles the switch and fires input and change.
keyboard.Enter: Submits the owning form (implicit submission, as on a native checkbox); does not toggle. See Q2.

aria: role=switch on the native checkbox; checked state exposed natively (aria-checked is not set by hand).
aria-describedby on the control lists the description and, while validation is error, the error message.
aria-invalid=true on the control while validation is error.
required exposed natively by the required attribute on the control.
Thumb and track are presentational (aria-hidden); state is never conveyed by color alone: thumb position also changes.
announcements: On toggle the screen reader announces the new state (on/off) from the native role=switch.

useCases.when: A single setting that is either on or off, such as enabling notifications.
A setting that needs a short explanation.
useCases.use: <sb-switch name="airplane" label="Airplane mode" description="Turns off all wireless connections."></sb-switch>

useCases.when: A setting that must be on before the form submits.

antiPatterns.pattern: Using a switch for a choice between two options that are not on and off (e.g. light/dark), or for a mixed state.
antiPatterns.why: WAI-ARIA APG: a switch represents on/off, not a pair of named values, and has no mixed state.
antiPatterns.alternative: Radio group or Toggle Group for named options; Checkbox for indeterminate.

antiPatterns.pattern: Changing the label text to reflect the state ("On"/"Off").
antiPatterns.why: WAI-ARIA APG: the label should not change when the state changes; the state is already announced.
antiPatterns.alternative: Keep a fixed label that names the setting.

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: UI and API from the visual reference, keyboard and ARIA from the WAI-ARIA APG Switch pattern, names from spec/api.json, tokens from the existing semantic layer (size.switch.*, space.switch.inset).

openQuestions.question: Which native element backs the switch: <input type=checkbox role=switch> or <button role=switch aria-checked>?
openQuestions.recommendation: <input type=checkbox role=switch>: native checked state, required/valueMissing and the browser's validation message for the validation anchor, and the shared NativeControl mixin applies as is.
openQuestions.answer: Accepted recommendation (no approver available in session).

openQuestions.question: Should Enter toggle the switch (APG lists it as optional)?
openQuestions.recommendation: No. Space toggles; Enter submits the owning form, as on a native checkbox and the other NativeControl controls. Keeps one keyboard model for every form control.
openQuestions.answer: Accepted recommendation (no approver available in session).

openQuestions.question: Does validation=error change the form validity (a custom error), or is it presentation only?
openQuestions.recommendation: Presentation only: validation and errorMessage show the error look, set aria-invalid and describe the error; form validity comes from required (native valueMissing). The app that decides the error (e.g. server-side) also blocks its own submit.
openQuestions.answer: Accepted recommendation (no approver available in session).

openQuestions.question: What does form.reset() restore: the last checked property, or the checked attribute?
openQuestions.recommendation: The checked attribute (defaultChecked semantics of the native checkbox); checked does not reflect, so the attribute stays the default.
openQuestions.answer: Accepted recommendation (no approver available in session).

openQuestions.question: Which two sizes, and what changes between them?
openQuestions.recommendation: small and medium from the size vocabulary; only the track and thumb change (size.switch.* semantic tokens), the text stays at body size.
openQuestions.answer: Accepted recommendation (no approver available in session).

openQuestions.question: Where is the label, and is a hideLabel option needed?
openQuestions.recommendation: Label after the track, fixed; no hideLabel for now, since the visible label is also what makes the small size meet the 24px target size. Add hideLabel later only if asked.
openQuestions.answer: Accepted recommendation (no approver available in session).
